title: nsk2k04/UniSphere-Rag-PDF-Chatbot
summary: UniSphere是一个基于AI的文档智能平台，利用检索增强生成（RAG）、语义搜索、向量嵌入和大型语言模型，将PDF文件转换为交互式知识库。该平台支持PDF文档的智能处理，适用于需要高效文档分析和知识提取的场景。
description: UniSphere is an AI-powered document intelligence platform that transforms PDFs into interactive knowledge bases using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, vector embeddings, and large language models.
